oneLine: Emami announces Rs 282 crore share buyback

sources.title: Buyback Alert! Emami announces Rs 282 crore share buyback — Check premium, price and other details
Emami shares jump 7% as board approves buyback plans of ₹282 crore; check price, other details

synopsis: Emami Ltd announced a share buyback of its fully paid-up equity shares through the open market route for an aggregate amount of up to Rs 282 crore. The board approved a maximum price of Rs 475 per share, representing a premium over the prevailing market price. The company will purchase between approximately 44.53 lakh and 59.37 lakh shares, representing around 1.36 per cent of its existing paid-up equity share capital, utilising a minimum amount of Rs 211.50 crore. The company explicitly stated that its promoters, members of the promoter group, persons in control, and their associates will not participate in the buyback.
